question: In March 2022, which Indian cricketer broke Kapil Dev's record for the highest score by an Indian player batting at number 7 or below in Test cricket by scoring an unbeaten 175 in a Test match against Sri Lanka?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ravindra Jadeja**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Ravindra Jadeja is a renowned Indian cricketer known for his all-round capabilities.
 
• In March 2022, he scored an unbeaten 175 against Sri Lanka, breaking Kapil Dev's record for the highest score by an Indian player batting at number 7 or below in Test cricket.
 
• Jadeja's performance in that match was instrumental in helping India secure a strong position.
 
• He is known for his exceptional fielding skills and has been a crucial part of the Indian cricket team in all formats of the game.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kapil Dev**

 
 
• Kapil Dev is a former Indian cricketer who served as the captain of the Indian cricket team which won the 1983 Cricket World Cup.
 
• He was known for his fast bowling and his ability to contribute valuable runs lower down the order.
 
• Kapil Dev held the record for the highest score by an Indian player batting at number 7 or below in Test cricket before Ravindra Jadeja broke it.
 
• He is considered one of the greatest all-rounders in the history of cricket.
 
 
 
• **Test Cricket**
 
 
• Test cricket is the longest form of the sport of cricket and is considered its highest standard.
 
• The game is played over five days, and each team has two innings.
 
• It is a test of endurance, skill, and strategy, making it a prestigious format in cricket.
 
• Player performances in Test cricket are highly regarded and contribute significantly to a player's legacy.
 
 
 
• **Ravindra Jadeja's Role in Indian Cricket**
 
 
• Ravindra Jadeja is an all-rounder, contributing significantly with both bat and ball.
 
• He made his debut for the Indian cricket team in 2009 and has since been a vital player in all formats of the game.
 
• Jadeja is particularly known for his left-arm orthodox spin and his sharp fielding abilities.
 
• His performances have often turned matches in India's favor, earning him a reputation as a match-winner.
